summary.text: Brian Close is a Democratic member of the Montana House of Representatives who has represented District 65 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Republican Joe Flynn.
A tax attorney by profession, he has served on several Bozeman civic boards.

paragraphs.text: Close was born in Highland Park, Illinois, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Chicago in 1981, a graduate degree in tax law from New York University Law School in 1988, and a graduate degree in history from Montana State University in 2001.
His career experience includes working as a tax attorney.
Close has served on the GALAVAN Board, the Bozeman City Study Commission and the Bozeman Park and Recreation Board, and he received an Intellectual Freedom Award from the Montana Library Association.
Close lost the 2020 Democratic primary for House District 61 to incumbent Jim Hamilton.
He won the 2024 Democratic primary for District 65 over Anja Wookey-Huffman and the general election over Republican Esther Fishbaugh, 55.7 percent to 44.3 percent.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the House Taxation and Human Services committees.
